observations.body: You shall remember all the way which the LORD your God has led you these forty years in the wilderness, that he might humble you, to test you, to know what was in…
observations.label: Text in view

observations.body: Moses recalls leading, hunger, manna, clothing, and testing in the wilderness.
observations.label: Forty years reviewed

observations.body: Hunger, manna, clothing, and bodily preservation become evidence in a command to remember.
observations.label: Wilderness role

payload.posture: Read Deuteronomy 8:1–4 as its own wilderness scene before relating it to other journeys, memories, or visions.
payload.tension: Testing and care share the same route without becoming the same action.
payload.title: Forty years remembered
